_comment: Kinds of findings the user may accept (plan 060, B-23, B-24). Per kind: the child skill and its detail section, an optional match on the item, the key (one field, or a list of fields), the facts kept with the entry, an optional source (the child source that must have been read; a value @field is taken from the entry's facts), and per watched field how it brings an accepted item back: changed (any other value), rises (a larger number), later (a later UTC time). A field under facts[] is compared per target fact, by path. A null on one side is not compared: that field is not_checked, never back. A null on both sides is equal only when it was read: a target fact was read when its file does not exist (exists false) or exists with no error beside the field (sha256 with sha256_error); a file whose existence was not confirmed was not read; both sides must be read, and an item whose kept fields were not read (facts_from_baseline, a check_error, unread_fields) is not_checked as a whole. No threshold is in code.
